တုန်လှုပ်ခြင်း။

pariphandita：ပရိ-ဖန္ဒိတ （တိ） （တီ-ကိတ်） （ပရိ√ဖန္ဒ်+က္တ）
တုန်လှုပ်သည်။
DOP: pariphandati paripphandati pr. 3 sg. [ S. parispandate], trembles, quivers; pulsates; moves to and fro; Dhp 34 (~at’ idaṃ cittaṃ māradheyyaṃ pahātave; Dhp-a I 289, 8 foll.: yathā … thale khitto maccho udakaṃ alabhanto ~ati evaṃ idaṃ … cittaṃ … ~ati saṇṭhātuṃ na sakkoti); Mp III 377, 9 (saṃsappatī ti paripphandati); — part.pr. ( a ) neg. apari(p)phandanta, mfn. Ud-a 342, 21 (so ca susikkhitattā apariphandanto nipajji, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se aparipphandanto); ( b ) pari(p)phandamāna, mfn. , Sn 776 (passāmi loke ~amānaṃ pajaṃ imaṃ taṇhāgataṃ bhavesu; Pj II 517, 6 : ito c’ ito ca phandamānaṃ); 1145 (paṅke sayāno ~amāno dīpā dīpaṃ upaplaviṃ; Nidd II 199, 9 : pavedhamāno sampavedhamāno); Ja IV 93, 9´ ; Th-a III 28, 28 (pāsena baddho migo … paripphandamāno); — pp pariphandita , n. [ cf S. parispandita], motion, activity; Ja III 24, 25* (kathaṃ hi … moghā te assu ~āni; 25, 4´ : ~ānī ti sukhaseyyāpucchanavasena vācāphanditāni sammajjanādikāraṇena kāyaphanditāni ca tava kathaṃ aphalāni bhavissanti).
